title: Using a Blood Test to Monitor Metastatic Breast Cancer Treatment
official: Using a Liquid Biopsy to Monitor Metastatic Breast Cancer Treatment
summary: The goal of this observational study is to assess the effectiveness of the mDETECT breast cancer blood test at monitoring treatment response in women with metastatic breast cancer undergoing treatment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

-Adult women (≥ 18 years of age) with proven diagnosis of adenocarcinoma of the breast with evidence of recurrent or metastatic disease not amenable to resection or radiation therapy with curative intent \[to be herein described as 'metastatic'\]
